summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing a monthly return (FF301) to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under Chapter 19B, reporting movements in its authorised and issued share capital for June 2026. The filing details a reduction in issued Class A shares by 30,106,483 (from 3,356,594,900 to 3,326,488,417) and Class B shares by 1,230,427 (from 137,181,078 to 135,950,651), with no change in authorised capital or treasury shares. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of share movements, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event-driven action is present.
